queries:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(length) AS avg_length,
    AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT AVG(avg_length), AVG(avg_ratio)
FROM rating_averages

SELECT
  rating,
  AVG(length) AS avg_length,
  AVG(1.0 * rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_rate_to_cost_ratio
FROM film
WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
GROUP BY rating

SELECT
  rating,
  AVG(length) AS avg_length,
  AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_rate_to_cost_ratio
FROM film
WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  AND length IS NOT NULL
  AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND replacement_cost IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY rating

SELECT
  rating,
  AVG(length) AS avg_length,
  AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_rate_to_cost
FROM film
WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  AND length IS NOT NULL
  AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND replacement_cost IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY rating;

SELECT
  AVG(avg_length) AS avg_length,
  AVG(avg_rental_rate / avg_replacement_cost) AS avg_rate_cost_ratio
FROM (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(length) AS avg_length,
    AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)

SELECT
  rating,
  AVG(length) AS avg_length,
  AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(replacement_cost) AS rate_to_cost_ratio
FROM film
WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
GROUP BY rating
